mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through continuous monetary policy easing.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in industrial production indicates broad-based economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:National Bureau of Economic Research Business Cycle Indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20d returns on UNRATE and INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a CPIAUCSL reading above 195 signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive policy and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 195
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 195, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts reflects robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through continuous demand growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 45% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 115.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced spending expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when HOUST falls > 1.0% and RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery, a declining unemployment rate alongside strong payroll growth signals improving labor conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 45% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).
